summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, attaching a press release updating its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on April 30, 2026. During the week of August 10–14, 2026, ING repurchased 975,000 shares at an average price of €30.80, totaling €30.03 million. Cumulative repurchases reached 20,740,193 shares at an average price of €27.21, for €564.3 million, representing 56.43% of the programme's maximum value. The buyback aims to reduce share capital. No advisors or board recommendations were disclosed. Watch for continued weekly updates and completion pace.
